evals.prompt: Explain the whole project to a new stakeholder, from the start to where we are now.
evals.expected_output: Reads every document tier and the git history, builds a dated timeline, and writes one plain-language story with the fixed section order, including a list of what has never actually been run.
expectations: Asks who the reader is unless the user already said
Reads docs/README.md first and every tier rather than sampling
Tells each phase as situations a person lived through, with the cause in plain words
Keeps a 'never actually been run' list with the same weight as what works
Writes no reported tag and changes no source document
